item.title: Make the Ankara Summit About European Defense Autonomy
item.description: As NATO meets in Ankara amid transatlantic strain, European allies must present the Trump administration with a burden-shifting roadmap, put its defense industry on a wartime footing, and advance NATO-EU cooperation by addressing Turkey’s role in European defense.

item.title: What Does NATO Defense Spending Look Like Heading into the Ankara Summit?
item.description: As NATO allies meet in Ankara this week, defense spending will likely be on the agenda. Seamus Daniels outlines recent trends as NATO commits to increased spending.

item.title: How the Iran War Weighs on the U.S.-Saudi Partnership and Prospects for Normalization with Israel
item.description: Saudi Arabia neither sought nor engaged in the Iran war, yet it was forced to manage its consequences. The conflict has reinforced Riyadh’s determination to reduce regional instability while avoiding entanglement in crises beyond its control.

item.title: Occupational Risk? Chinese Presence Surges at Scarborough Shoal
item.description: CCG presence at Scarborough doubles in 2026.

item.title: The United States Has Opted Not to Extend the USMCA
item.description: The United States declined to renew the USMCA for another 16 years, triggering a decade of annual reviews. But the deal did not collapse. It now faces a slower, costlier threat: prolonged uncertainty that stalls investment across North America.

item.title: What to Know About Chinese AI Models
item.description: Chinese AI models are rapidly closing the gap with U.S. frontier systems. This analysis examines what their growing capabilities, lower costs, and open-weight strategy mean for global AI competition and U.S. policy.

item.title: Reflecting on U.S. Development Policy on the United States’ 250th Anniversary
item.description: As the United States marks its 250th anniversary, it faces a defining question: What role should development play in U.S. global leadership? This commentary explores why development remains central to U.S. strategy, trust, and leadership in an era of disruption.
